name: E-470 Public Highway Authority
chain: CDOT Standard Specifications + M&S Standards ('current versions at the date of the permit application')

clear_zone_ft.note: AASHTO Roadside Design Guide clear zone from edge stripe of nearest travel lane; no materials/equipment storage in it; excavations closed daily; no open excavation in the clear zone after dark.

other.rule: ROW = 300 ft (fee basis); MUE Utility Zone 50 ft / Landscape Zone 25 ft. No other geometry — MUTCD + Colorado Supplement + Authority requirements govern.

deltas.rule: No TC devices within 2 ft of the outermost solid white line during peak windows; no work impacting mainline lanes in peaks.

trigger.condition: peak windows (weekdays 6-9 a.m., 3-7 p.m., holidays, day prior to holidays)

deltas.rule: Median crossing prohibited (drive to nearest interchange); no equipment on travel lanes without an approved MHT; workers' personal vehicles never on Authority Property; materials/equipment removed from ROW at close of daily operations.
TCP must include emergency-vehicle passage provisions and shall conform to the requirements of the Americans with Disabilities Act.

windows.note: Widest peak windows in the corpus (7 banned hours/weekday).

hours.override_note: No night, Saturday, Sunday, or holiday work except as approved; the Authority may restrict for weather/visibility.

conflict.label: afternoon peak window
conflict.verdict: Rendering 3:00–7:00 PM; where the SPPO and the 2025 Manual conflict, the Manual governs.

personnel.rule: All TC-requiring work supervised by a registered professional traffic engineer OR an ATSSA/CCA-certified TCS additionally certified as 'Worksite Traffic Supervisor'; the TCS owns planning through inspection of the TCP. Strongest personnel gate in the corpus.
All flaggers certified with current card.

devices.rule: Devices per MUTCD + Colorado Supplement; TCS monitors devices during closures and when left in place multiple days; damage to Authority TC devices repaired immediately before other work continues.

hazards.rule: Damaging the TBMS fiber line: $50,000 per day per occurrence liquidated damages — the largest single penalty in the corpus. 4-ft clearance required; 48-hour witnessed-locate protocol; prescribed support/protection details.
Unpermitted work = trespass: fines up to 2x the permit fee per unauthorized entry (also against the Facility Owner/contractor); barring from property; 3rd-degree criminal trespass referral.

notes.rule: Insurance certificate before any work (limits published on the Authority's website — not captured). Payment, Performance AND Warranty Bond, amount set by the Authority, dual-obligee acceptable, not released until As-Builts accepted.
1-year warranty from Final Acceptance (As-Builts are the gate — no future permits processed until submitted); finished-work maintenance 24 months; landscaping maintained in perpetuity.

PE-stamped plans on E-470 As-Builts in PDF and MicroStation V8; Quality Control Plan before work; testing per controlling municipality/county or CDOT, whichever is more stringent; results in 48 hrs, reports in 72.
In-kind payment: the Authority may accept materials/services in lieu of cash — unique in the corpus.

multi_agency.rule: The TCP must be reviewed and approved by the appropriate cross-street jurisdictions — the Authority forces multi-jurisdiction TCP approval (reciprocal with Parker's checklist, which attaches E-470 permits).

source.doc: E-470 application page / Board Resolution 05-04 schedule
E-470 application page / Board Resolution 05-04 schedule

formula.note: Permit Fee = $75,000 per acre of disturbance (published formula; e.g. a 1 ft x 15 ft disturbance = $25.83). Board Resolution 05-04. Inspection fees prepaid on projected schedule; consultant inspector reimbursed including travel time.

meters.note: $50,000 per day per occurrence liquidated damages.

leads.label: Permit review
leads.note: 10-20 business days; complex applications longer; dormant applications closed at 3 months.

leads.label: Start / resume notice
leads.note: 2 working days notice before starting, or resuming after a 5+ day suspension.

notices.rule: TCP reviewed and approved by the appropriate cross-street jurisdictions before Authority work.
Locates two business days ahead (the Authority locates its own facilities).
